annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidencia de la República de Cuba (Yaima Puig Meneses)
key_provisions_or_claims: Cuba's AI Development Strategy was approved by the Council of Ministers in May 2024.
Strategy has six axes: ethics and regulatory framework, human capital, applications and services, public administration, science and innovation, social communication.
Ministry of Communications leads AI governance, supported by a Technical Advisory Council.
President urges AI content in all education levels and postgraduate studies.
Software automation 'robot' issues about 30% of Justice Ministry certifications; partnership with China on an AI institute.
annotation.summary_en: Official Cuban presidency news report on a January 2025 meeting where President Díaz-Canel and the Communications Minister presented Cuba's AI Development Strategy (approved May 2024). It covers six strategic axes, institutional leadership, risks, education plans, current projects and partnerships, with an innovation-promotion emphasis.
annotation.title_clean: Cuba tiene potencialidades para estar en la avanzada de la Inteligencia Artificial en la región latinoamericana y caribeña
annotation.title_en: Cuba has the potential to be at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence in Latin America and the Caribbean
